Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CREATION
Topic 1.1: Origin and Consequences of Sin

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Origin and Consequences of Sin
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important to consider the consequences of something before acting?
